notes.text:
An update is available for kernel-rt.
This update affects Rocky Linux 8.
A Common Vulnerability Scoring System (CVSS) base score, which gives a detailed severity rating, is available for each vulnerability from the CVE list
notes.title: Topic

notes.text:
The kernel-rt packages provide the Real Time Linux Kernel, which enables fine-tuning for systems with extremely high determinism requirements.

Security Fix(es):

* kernel: xfrm: espintcp: do not reuse an in-progress partial send (CVE-2026-52935)

* kernel: USB: serial: io_ti: fix heap overflow in get_manuf_info() (CVE-2026-53196)

* kernel: sctp: keep chunk->transport in step with the list it is queued on (CVE-2026-74588)

* kernel: sctp: validate cookie AUTH state before use (CVE-2026-74752)

* kernel: smb: client: reject a tree connect response whose byte count is too small (CVE-2026-89631)

* kernel: sctp: stop processing a packet once its association is deleted (CVE-2026-89479)

* kernel: perf: Fix addr_filter_ranges lifetime (CVE-2026-93817)

* kernel: netfilter: nfnetlink_log: wait for rcu grace period before freeing pernet state (CVE-2026-93288)

* kernel: kernel: strparser: use-after-free via msg_timer_work rearm after strp_done() cancellation ()

* kernel: netfilter: flowtable: hold reference on ct until flow is released (CVE-2026-98320)

Bug Fix(es) and Enhancement(s):

*  gfs2 filesystem withdrawal rework [Rocky Linux-8] (JIRA:Rocky Linux-129363)

* Batch: z-stream xfrm - rhel-8.10.z (NST-Core-26W38) (JIRA:Rocky Linux-256684)

For more details about the security issue(s), including the impact, a CVSS score, acknowledgments, and other related information, refer to the CVE page(s) listed in the References section.

This advisory is provided by Ctrl IQ, Inc for Rocky Linux systems. For more information about CIQ security practices, visit https://ciq.com/security.
